# Email Address

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](gmeow-EmailAddress.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EmailAddress>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A contact point reachable via the Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](gmeow-ContactPoint.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](gmeow-EmailAddress.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](gmeow-ContactPoint.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Message Thread

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/email/examples/message-thread.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/email/examples/message-thread.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-email-examples-message-thread)#example-slices-extensions-email-examples-message-thread

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: an email message and its reply . A gmeow:EmailMessage
# carries the RFC 5322 envelope as first-class edges to gmeow:EmailAddresses —
# gmeow:from, gmeow:to, gmeow:cc — plus a gmeow:subject. Threading is a relation
# between messages, not a flat field: a reply points at what it answers with
# gmeow:inReplyTo, so the conversation graph is reconstructable from the messages
# themselves. The EmailAddresses are the reified gmeow:ContactPoints of the
# contacts slice — the same objects a person reaches mail through.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/email/> .

ex:aliceAddr a gmeow:EmailAddress ; gmeow:addressValue "alice@example.org" .
ex:bobAddr   a gmeow:EmailAddress ; gmeow:addressValue "bob@example.org" .
ex:carolAddr a gmeow:EmailAddress ; gmeow:addressValue "carol@example.org" .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for an email contact point whose addr-spec structure (local part, domain part) or delivery target matters, or that an agent holds over a tenure.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the plain string convenience (use the [`gmeow:email`](../properties/gmeow-email.md) datatype property on the agent) and for the mailbox the address delivers into (that is [`gmeow:OnlineAccount`](gmeow-OnlineAccount.md), reached via [`gmeow:deliversToAccount`](../properties/gmeow-deliversToAccount.md)).

### How to use

- Mint the address as an [`EmailAddress`](gmeow-EmailAddress.md), fill [`gmeow:addressValue`](../properties/gmeow-addressValue.md) (and the parts where parsed), link delivery with [`gmeow:deliversToAccount`](../properties/gmeow-deliversToAccount.md), and carry its personal sensitivity so it is not leaked to a public consumer.

### Examples

- ex:lillithEmail a [`gmeow:EmailAddress`](gmeow-EmailAddress.md); [`gmeow:addressValue`](../properties/gmeow-addressValue.md) "lillith@example.org".

### Use For Consumers

- [`gmeow:consumerAgentMemory`](../individuals/gmeow-consumerAgentMemory.md)

### Avoid For Consumers
